lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: graphing exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: graphing exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: A polynomial has degree 4 and leading coefficient 4. Describe its end behaviour.
choices: the left end falls and the right end rises
the left end rises and the right end falls

items.prompt: For f(x) = (x + 7) / (x + 5), state the vertical asymptote and the horizontal asymptote.
Function f is given in vertex form as f(x) = −2(x − 2)² − 5, so it opens downward. Function g is given by a table whose greatest output is 0. Which function has the greater maximum, and by how much?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: The function f(x) = 3(x − 4)² − 2 opens upward. State its minimum value and where it occurs.
A polynomial has degree 2 and leading coefficient -1. Describe its end behaviour.
choices: the left end falls and the right end rises
the left end rises and the right end falls

items.prompt: For f(x) = (x − 3) / (x + 3), state the vertical asymptote and the horizontal asymptote.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt: Function f is given in vertex form as f(x) = −2(x − 4)² + 9, so it opens downward. Function g is given by a table whose greatest output is 13. Which function has the greater maximum, and by how much?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: The function f(x) = (x + 7)² − 4 opens upward. State its minimum value and where it occurs.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
